title: Mark Up a Navigation Bar
description: Write a semantic navigation section with proper nesting and attributes.
problemStatement:
A common website pattern is a header containing a logo and navigation links. Create a semantic header structure:

- Use a `<header>` element to wrap everything.
- Inside, add an `<h1>` with the site name "Progly Academy". Give it an `id` of `site-logo`.
- Add a `<nav>` element (semantic!) that contains an unordered list (`<ul>`) with three links: Home, Courses, Contact.
- Each list item (`<li>`) must contain an `<a>` tag. The `href` can be `#`.
- Apply a `class` of `main-nav` to the `<nav>` and a `class` of `nav-link` to each `<a>`.

Ensure proper nesting: `<nav>` > `<ul>` > `<li>` > `<a>`.
hints: The `<header>` can contain more than just the `<h1>`; navigation is often included.
Remember that `<ul>` and `<li>` are block elements, while `<a>` is inline.
Indent each level of nesting so you can easily see the parent‑child relationships.
expectedOutput: A semantic header with a site title and a navigation list. Code should be valid and neatly indented.
solutionCode:
Progly Academy

  • Home
  • Courses
  • Contact
